chunk_findings.detail: The regression never builds the plan the bug describes. With F1–F3 already held and `cap=3`, `plan` takes the no-free-slot branch (`why` starts with the existing "cap reached" string). The failure mode in the task is the other branch: a free slot offered to a higher-ranked item that may have no lease, so the detail no longer says "cap reached" and a lane cannot tell wait from claim. Dropping `{named}` from only the `if slots:` assignment in `_plan.py` (the string that actually ships in that case) still satisfies both asserts. The test also never checks that a named claim of the capped id succeeds, so "grants it now" is an unpinned promise.
